Name: Artisan Products Copy Quality
Author: justastranger
TagLine: Enables the CopyQuality flag on every recipe for every machine that produces artisan goods.
Description:
I made this mod over a week ago and only now decided to upload it after playing with it for a while and making sure it works.

This mod does one simple thing: Enable the CopyQuality flag on every recipe for every machine that it is configured to do so for.

You can configure the mod by adding or removing the Qualified Item ID of the machine to/from the list of targeted machines. The config can be edited either through the use of Generic Mod Config Menu or by manually modifying the config file. By default, this targets all of the normal artisan goods producing machines.

Downloads.Description: Makes machines that produce artisan goods copy the quality from input to output

Manifest.Name: Artisan Products Copy Quality
Manifest.Description: Iterates through certain machines and all of their outputs so the CopyQuality flag can be enabled. Replicates 'Quality Artisan Products' in pure SMAPI code that is much easier to expand.
